description: Critical debt patterns that block pipeline. Per AGENTS.md S0.2 First-Principles: these are NOT advisory - they are physical barriers.

critical_blockers.name: import_encapsulation_violation
critical_blockers.description: core/orchestration/ and core/gateway/ must not directly import verification/. Use verification_interface.nim instead.

critical_blockers.name: bare_except_clauses
critical_blockers.description: Bare 'except:' catches Defects. Use 'except CatchableError:' per Nim best practices.

critical_blockers.name: stub_test_files
critical_blockers.description: Test files with check true density > 50% violate AGENTS.md S0.8 No Stub Files.
critical_blockers.remediation: Replace stub assertions with observable behavior verification

critical_blockers.name: zombie_imports
critical_blockers.description: Imports referencing deleted or non-existent modules.
critical_blockers.remediation: Remove or update the import to reference a valid module

critical_blockers.name: acyclic_missing_on_ref_object
critical_blockers.description: ref object without {.acyclic.} annotation - ORC cycle collector overhead per AGENTS.md S0.6a.
critical_blockers.remediation: Add {.acyclic.} pragma to the ref object type

critical_blockers.name: include_statements_outside_parts
critical_blockers.description: include statements outside _parts/ file splitting violate AGENTS.md S2.6.
